title: Blackwood Salt E-Liquid – Royal Oak 30ml
description:
Description
Cherry Whisky Tobacco. A tantalizing blend of sweet and ripe black cherries and aged whisky with a warm bodied sweet Cuban tobacco finish. Royal Oak offers a delectable flavor with just the right blend of tobacco. All day vape certified and downright delicious!
30ml Bottle
50% VG 50% PG
Introducing Bold 50!
In response to the new nicotine cap, Blackwood is now offering a unique hybrid nicotine blend crafted to provide the throat hit you know and love from the original 50mg/ml nicotine salt e-liquid, but are only 20mg/ml.
